articles.title: GLP-1 Clinical Benefits for Obstructive Sleep Apnea Highlighted at CHEST 2026
articles.summary: New clinical findings presented at CHEST 2026 demonstrate the ongoing efficacy of GLP-1 medications in treating obstructive sleep apnea. This expanding clinical utility directly impacts self-funded employers as they weigh the long-term cost benefits against surging utilization and plan design coverage decisions for weight-loss drugs.
articles.source_line: Source: Managed Healthcare Executive; Sat, 17 Oct 2026 21:45:52 GMT

articles.title: 340B Rebate Pilot Projected to Cost Hospitals Over $1 Billion Annually
articles.summary: A proposed 340B rebate pilot program is estimated to cost participating hospitals between $537 million and over $1 billion annually, sparking intense debate between federal regulators and healthcare providers. As 340B program dynamics continue to shift, these regulatory and pricing changes directly impact the broader drug distribution and cost ecosystem relevant to pharmacy benefit managers and self-funded plan sponsors.
articles.source_line: Source: Medical Daily; Sat, 17 Oct 2026 18:43:10 GMT

articles.title: GLP-1 Cost Surge Drives Pharmacy Strategy Urgency for Employers
articles.summary: Rising expenditures on GLP-1 medications are forcing employers, particularly in industries like staffing, to reevaluate their pharmacy benefit strategies. Self-funded plans must implement targeted utilization management and plan designs to control these specialty drug costs without sacrificing talent attraction. This highlights the growing pressure on employer-sponsored health plans to optimize pharmacy benefit management.
articles.source_line: Source: Staffing Industry Analysts; Sat, 17 Oct 2026 09:05:50 GMT
